LanguageData.LiAIChat_SporeLungInfection.label: spore lung infection
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SporeLungInfection.description: Alien spores accumulate in this natural lung. Severity lowers this lung's efficiency; severe infection also slows movement. Detoxifier lungs protect only the lung they replace; a single detoxifier lung also halves the remaining exposure.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosiveTissueDamage.label: corrosive tissue damage
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosiveTissueDamage.descripti: Corrosive residue damages this natural arm and reduces its efficiency. Artificial arms and missing limbs are not affected. Medical tending and time away from the weapon help recovery.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_NeuralResonanceStrain.label: neural resonance strain
LanguageData.LiAIChat_NeuralResonanceStrain.descripti: Repeated resonance exposure overloads the nervous system. Severe strain lowers consciousness and causes pain. It cannot by itself kill the pawn and recovers when exposure stops.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ToxicAccumulation.label: toxic accumulation
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ToxicAccumulation.description: The absorber armor's stored pollution is leaking into the wearer's body. Detoxifier lungs reduce the buildup but cannot eliminate it.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_DermalErosion.label: dermal erosion
LanguageData.LiAIChat_DermalErosion.description: The retaliator carapace's symbiotic spines irritate and damage the wearer's skin. Severe erosion causes pain and recovers slowly.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_DermalErosion.stages.0.label: minor
LanguageData.LiAIChat_DermalErosion.stages.1.label: moderate
LanguageData.LiAIChat_DermalErosion.stages.2.label: severe
LanguageData.LiAIChat_DermalErosion.stages.3.label: dangerous
